title: 调课、补课、孩子请假
titleEn: We can arrange a make-up class
goal: 家长说孩子要请假或者想换上课时间时，能用英语安排补课、确认时间。

chunks.en: Can we change the class to Friday?
chunks.zh: 可以把课改到星期五吗？

chunks.en: We can arrange a make-up class.
What time is good for you?
Thank you for letting me know.
chunks.note: 家长请假、通知事情时，用这句回复很礼貌。

drill.pattern: Can we change the class to ___?
drill.zh: 问能不能换到别的时间

fills.zh: 可以改到星期天早上吗？

grammar.title: can 和 can't
grammar.body: can 是"能、可以"，can't 是"不能"。两个词很像：can't 的 a 读得更开、更长，结尾还有一个轻轻的 t。听不清时，可以问 Can or cannot?

dialogue.title: 爸爸打电话给孩子请假
dialogue.setting: Jayden 的爸爸打电话到补习中心，说 Jayden 今天不能来上课。

npc.en: Hi, this is Jayden's father. Jayden can't come for class today.
npc.zh: 你好，我是 Jayden 的爸爸。Jayden 今天不能来上课。

replies.en: Okay. Thank you for letting me know.

npc.en: Yes, he has a fever. Can he do a make-up class?
npc.zh: 是的，他发烧了。他可以补课吗？

replies.en: We can arrange a make-up class.

npc.en: That's great. When can he come?
npc.zh: 太好了。他什么时候可以来？

replies.en: What time is good for you?

npc.en: Friday at 5pm is good for us.
npc.zh: 星期五下午五点我们可以。

replies.en: No problem. I will check the timetable.

task: 今天如果有家长请假或通知你什么事，用英语回一句：Thank you for letting me know.
